_backstory: Ramkali Devi is a 38-year-old widow and small farmer from Sitapur district, UP. She owns 1.2 acres of land and grows wheat. Her daughter passed Class 10 with distinction and wants to pursue Class 11. Ramkali's annual income from farming is around ₹65,000. She belongs to the OBC category, has an Aadhaar card, income certificate, land record, and caste certificate. Her son Vikram manages the app for her.

Suresh Kumar is a 24-year-old daily wage labourer from Balrampur district, UP. He recently got married and his wife is 3 months pregnant. He belongs to the SC category with an annual household income of about ₹42,000. He has an Aadhaar card but does NOT yet have an income certificate (required for the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana claim). His wife Kavita has a ration card but no bank account in her own name — a missing field that blocks the application.
